entries.title: Twelve-arc linear population-reserve candidate
entries.source_lifecycle: unreviewed candidate in a draft source PR; imported claim not audited for destination promotion

claim.statement: For every finite planar unit-separated n-point global diameter minimizer with D>16384, g_A=n-1-pi*D^2/(2*sqrt(3)) >= gamma*D-sqrt(D)/(4*sqrt(2))-60, where gamma=3*(576*b-65)/(114695*a) and a=sqrt(3)/2, b=sqrt(3)-98/65. In particular g_A>=D/600 for D>=10^6.
hypotheses: D>16384 for the asymptotic formula; D>=10^6 for the convenient effective bound

relation_to_canonical.comparison_scope: The new candidate has a linear-order lower bound with an explicit negative square-root error and onset; for sufficiently large D it dominates the canonical D^(2/3) lower bounds. Their existing scopes and theorem-state status are unchanged.
relation_to_canonical.replacement_status: none; the source claim is not registered as a theorem and does not supersede canonical entries

obstructions_and_limits.result: The report constructs dense triangle-free feasible sources with high reserve; this blocks dropping global optimality from the proposed upper-reserve route, but does not refute the candidate theorem or the conjecture.
No source-specific upper reserve bound or strict-diameter competitor is supplied; triangle-free global minimizers are not excluded.

next_proof_obligations: An independent AI-agent mathematical audit of the exact destination commit, reconstructing the analytic averaging proof and adversarially checking the global-minimizer reduction, before any consequential promotion.
